title: Point-of-sale settlement batches
definition: The batch-level settlement file a merchant's acquirer or processor settles on, showing the individual card transactions and the net amount remitted. It is requested when a cash-heavy merchant's card volume is being compared with the rest of its takings, and it establishes the card side of the picture, not the cash side.
evidence_to_cite: the settlement batch, with the settlement date and the net amount
the individual transactions in the batch, cited by their own transaction ids
the acquirer's or processor's identification of the merchant account

sources.citation: Card settlement data is requested to test a cash-intensity profile; the reporting and recordkeeping context is summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
